evidence.reason: The finding’s issue was the SDK lane reading the CLI session sidecar from `record.workspace` instead of the shared session store. History shows commit `9b9b0c33b252ef36c09c7a59b9da3d393b24a1d9` titled “fix(scripts): Read abort sidecar from the session store,” which directly addresses this defect at the tip. No current-contract conflict appears; the fix aligns with the session-store behavior described by the finding.
